# Pt. Prashant Dubey Astrology

> Official website of Pt. Prashant Dubey, a Vedic astrologer (Jyotish expert) based in Varanasi (Kashi), Uttar Pradesh, India, with 26+ years of experience. Offers online and in-person consultations in Vedic astrology, numerology, Vastu Shastra, palmistry, gemstone guidance and matchmaking. Has guided 50,000+ clients across 15+ countries. Recipient of the Yuva Pratibha Award by the Akhil Bharatiya Vidvat Parishad, Kashi. Site languages: English and Hindi.

Consultations are held on Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp Video or in person in Varanasi. Office hours: Mon-Sat, 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM IST. Service area: India and worldwide (online).

## Services

- [Natal Chart Reading](https://www.prashantdubey.co.in/#services): Birth chart reading covering sun, moon, rising sign and planetary placements (60 min, Rs 2,500)
- [Vedic Jyotish](https://www.prashantdubey.co.in/#services): Lagna, Nakshatra and Dasha analysis with remedial measures (90 min, Rs 4,000)
- [Predictive Astrology](https://www.prashantdubey.co.in/#services): Transit, progression and Dasha-based forecast for the year ahead (75 min, Rs 3,200)
- [Vastu Shastra](https://www.prashantdubey.co.in/#services): Home, office and workspace Vastu consultation (60 min, Rs 3,500)
- [Synastry and Matchmaking](https://www.prashantdubey.co.in/#services): Compatibility and marriage matching for couples (90 min, Rs 3,800)
- [Numerology Reading](https://www.prashantdubey.co.in/#services): Life path, destiny and name-number analysis (45 min, Rs 2,000)
- [Palmistry and Face Reading](https://www.prashantdubey.co.in/#services): Palm and physiognomy reading (60 min, Rs 2,500)
- [Gemstone Consultation](https://www.prashantdubey.co.in/#services): Chart-based gemstone recommendations (45 min, Rs 1,800)
- [Quick Guidance](https://www.prashantdubey.co.in/#services): Focused 30-minute session on one question (Rs 550)
